notes.title: 🔥 SOLDAT 2 Released! 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36755538/504253b69f0fbe083e4cb62e50255161ba1031b5.gif[/img]

[h1]Soldat 2 Released on Steam![/h1]

[h3]Put on your rocket-boots and grab your gun. Soldat 2 is ready! [/h3]

[h2]🎮⚡️BEGIN! 🎮⚡️[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/474220/Soldat_2/

[h2]WATCH the TRAILER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=VCZQwggcK5M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Join the LIVE!Streaming event [url=https://www.facebook.com/events/648056772564464/?active_tab=about]here:[/url][/h2]
Can't join us today? No worries 😉
Grab your bowl with popcorn and watch the LIVE!Stream. 🍿
We made a special Facebook event with links to all the different live streams!

[h2]Early Access Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] online multiplayer (with dedicated servers)
[*] iconic physics-based movement
[*] essential multiplayer gamemodes (capture the flag, point capture, battle royale)
[*] procedurally generated and designed levels
[*] realistic weapons and military equipment
[*] ragdoll physics and over the top violence
[*] singleplayer & custom battle sandbox
[*] lo-fi mode for clarity or potato pc's
[*] built-in gif recording!
[/list]
[h2]Join our community on [b][url=https://discord.gg/Ar3QM7d]Soldat 2 Discord server! [/url][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36755538/46d22d5defca32e89b733958e2f4706022aeaa10.gif[/img]

See you in the battlefield...
And remember to have fun!
MM & THD Team

notes.title: Trench Run Build 16 Released!
notes.content:
A round of most important fixes.

Changes:
- lobby bug fixes
- sniper bot a bit less perfect
- map fixes
- wrong series-end conditions in cases of many ties

*we are aware of the "singleplayer crashes after playing multiplayer" bug, it will be fixed as soon as we find a solution*

[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/26AHPnN21m1sc4ypa/giphy.gif]
